candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives every common input and originates one complete executable policy state. The second call consumes that state, sees only the anchor contract and task constraints as external evidence, may correct only demonstrated contract incompatibility, and emits a sealed executable closure. The final call consumes only that closure and emits its enclosed policy unchanged.
